scores.visual_critic_note: Coherent dark theme with a restrained accent blue, uppercase panel labels with letter-spacing, and a purposeful grid layout elevate this well above generic, but the network panel reads as dense/cramped at rendered size and the thumbnail grid overwhelms the analytical panels below the fold.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Zero baseline correct, scaleSqrt used for all circle-area encoding, domains are data-driven via d3.extent/d3.max, but network node sizes silently rescale on filter (subset invariant violated) and bar joins lack key functions.
scores.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag pattern correctly coalesces visual redraws, but O(N) bitFilter computation runs synchronously in the brush event handler on every mousemove and the timeline scale would go stale on window resize.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Four linked views are well-organized and the single-accent color scheme avoids overload, but the 60-node force network renders as a dense hairball and the thumbnail wall adds a second high-density zone simultaneously visible, stretching working memory across three visually busy regions at once.
flags: Update Storm (bitFilter.set() + bitFilter.filtered() computed synchronously on every brush mousemove, not deferred by RAF)
Stale Scale (timeline x scale captured in closure with no ResizeObserver or resize handler)
Mouse-Touch Fight (timeline and color brushes have no .filter() guard against scroll/brush conflict on touch devices)

proposer: 928 lines, down 8 from 936. Removed 5 redundant section-header comments and merged `updateThumbWall` with `updaters.thumbs` by moving the active-tab check inside the function.
